system.description:
Medical Perfection: Supreme Medic – Hemorrhage Vitality.

Hemorrhage Vitality is a Physical Condition. Creatures suffer their body blood vessels and chakra network hemorrhaging, suffering the following effects while they have this condition;

They take 6d6 Necrotic and 6d6 Chakra damage at the beginning of each of their turns.

Cannot regain hit points.

Physical Conditions except this one, cannot be removed.

A creature with this condition makes a Constitution saving throw vs your Ninjutsu save DC at the end of each of their turns to end this condition.
system.summary: 6d6 necrotic and 6d6 chakra damage at the start of its turns; can't regain HP; its other Physical conditions can't be removed; Con save each turn ends it.

rules.text: It can't regain hit points, and its other Physical conditions can't be removed while it has this.
